findings.why: 'High purity' is a vague purity claim; the brand states grade or source precisely.
findings.fix: Keep the source only: 2% Alpha Arbutin, sourced from Alfa Aesar, USA.

tone_read: Educational and ingredient-led with no hype or fear.
language_read: Strength is stated in the right format and actives are named precisely. Only the vague high purity wording departs from brand habit.
